name: Clock
description: Every 1.2s, reliably. The metronome everything else is measured against.

name: On Hit
description: Whenever your effects damage an enemy. Very frequent — the core cascade fuel.

name: On Kill
description: Whenever an enemy dies to your effects. The classic cascade seed.

name: On Pickup
description: Whenever you collect fuel or XP. Turns movement into firepower.

name: On Crit
description: When a hit crits. Rare, so it hits x3. Scales hard with crit chance.

name: On Dash
description: When you dash. x3.5 payload on a 3s cooldown — mobility as a weapon.

name: On Wound
description: When you take damage. Rare and unwanted, so it pays x5. Pairs with Leech.

name: On Wave
description: When a new composition arrives. Very rare, x7 payload. The burst archetype.

name: On Overheat
description: When Heat hits 100. x8 payload — weaponises the penalty. Build around it.

name: On Convert
description: When a conversion resolves. x2.5 — the economy-engine payoff.
